values.note: 91 RV sites (89 Standard Electric, 2 RV Electric) take 25 to 45 ft - all of them fit a 23-ft motorhome, most take 36-40 ft - and 10 are pull-through; plus 10 tent-only primitive sites with electric and group water.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232559 ('91 sites with electric and water and 10 primitive sites with electric and group water') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (Max Vehicle Length 25-45 on the 91 RV sites, Driveway Entry Pull-through on 10), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $28 a night for a Standard Electric RV site in the 2026, 2027 and 2028 rate tables; tent-only electric sites $24.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232559/rates (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and 2027: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' 28, 'TENT ONLY ELECTRIC' 24), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 'LENGTH OF STAY: Limited to fourteen (14) days, consecutive or non-consecutive, on this project during any thirty (30) day consecutive period.' recreation.gov sets no weekend or holiday minimum (both rules 0). Check-in 4 PM, checkout 3 PM; the gate is closed 10 p.m. to 7 a.m.

summary: recreation.gov: confirmed 101 sites, $28 Standard Electric (2026-2028 tables; tent-only $24), reservable, phone (229) 768-3061, flush toilets/showers/dump (already recorded). Added max 45 ft (all 91 RV sites 25 ft+), 10 pull-throughs, the 14-in-30-days limit. Removed from the Claude part of the note the '2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums' (recreation.gov sets both to 0), plus the counts, amenities, booking and gate hours the fields/booking note hold; AWH text kept verbatim. Hookups left as recorded (catalog: 50 A, water and sewer 'Y' and 'Full Hookup 50' on all 91 RV sites, although the description says only 'electric and water'). Laundry not stated on rec.gov (left). The USACE Mobile District pages refuse plain HTTP (403). Pin 75 m from rec.gov's coordinates.
